items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Did we ever play for B? I think we did behind B or something and.

ctx.x: He was with the septet when I came back because I got one after the -- the recording in Stockholm. So Babs was in that group. He was, like, the manager 'cause he knew the ropes and I didn't, you know. Then, like, in Dizzy Gillespie's band, like, I played -- we played for, like, Savon [phonetic sp.], Ella Fitzgerald. Did we ever play for B? I think we did behind B or something and. -­
